top_issues: The educational callout card ('How to read this...') occupies high-value real estate above the primary action buttons, delaying direct interaction.
The distinction between '$155.00 Total balance' and the break-down items underneath is dense and risks initial confusion for first-time retail users.
fixes: Make 'How to read this' collapsible into an inline micro-badge or info icon next to the bar once dismissed, persisting dismiss state in local storage.
Group the three action pills (Pay, Receive, Swap) immediately below the main balance before explanatory callouts.

top_issues: Accounts card shows '+115.00 owes you' with secondary capacities ('send up to 175.00', 'receive up to 0.50') lacking clear visual differentiation between balance and credit boundary.
Bottom of the screen truncates the bottom navigation bar visual weight against card outlines.
fixes: Add subtle badge/pill styling around 'owes you' and 'send up to' limits to clearly demarcate credit headroom from settled balance.
Increase padding-bottom on the scroll container so 'All activity' clears comfortably above bottom navigation bar.

top_issues: The recipient address inside the 'To' card is a raw 42-char hex string with small contrast, which feels intimidating.
The 1:1 scale bar under 'This payment' shows only a white sliver, missing explicit labels for the bar's min/max bounds.
fixes: Show a verified handle or shortened checksum badge ('0x92c2...cbf0') with a clear copy/verify tap target.
Add explicit tick marks or micro-labels to the payment proportional indicator bar to ground the absolute scale visual.

top_issues: The expanded route selection shows two route cards where fee differences (0.000050 vs 0.000075 USDC) dominate visually while both state 'You send 25.00', obscuring route latency or hop safety.
Primary CTA 'Pay 25.00 USDC' sits close to route list bottom margin without clear visual breathing room.
fixes: Include hop count and execution certainty tag ('1 hop - Direct' vs '2 hops') in the route selection radio card.
Add 16px bottom margin above the sticky CTA container.

top_issues: The proof hash '0x59b55173...195c' cannot be tapped or copied directly from the modal line item.
Modal sheet header drag handle blends into background scrim without distinct contrast.
fixes: Make the proof row tap-to-copy with a brief inline checkmark animation.
Increase opacity of the top sheet drag handle to #4B5563 for clear dismissal affordance.

top_issues: Bottom action buttons (Copy receipt, Download, Print / PDF, Done) are horizontally cramped into four small pill buttons on mobile viewport.
Dimmed background card peek shows raw internal numbers that compete with receipt context.
fixes: Split bottom actions: make 'Done' full-width primary, with secondary actions (Share / Export PDF / Copy) as an icon row above it.
Increase backdrop blur/opacity on the modal scrim overlay to focus attention strictly on the proof artifact.

top_issues: QR code has an aggressive white rounded container that produces stark glare in dark mode.
'25.50 capacity via H1' notice next to optional amount can confuse users who just want to receive an arbitrary sum.
fixes: Use a subtle off-white or slightly muted warm background (#EDEDED) with 16px inner padding for the QR container.
Add an inline explanation tooltip to 'capacity via H1' or allow automatic capacity expansion prompt if incoming amount exceeds limit.

top_issues: The bottom section displays 'YOUR ENTITY ID' with dense cryptographic disclaimer text that overpowers the simple payment link action above it.
Multiple share actions are divided across 'Copy payment link', 'Print / PDF', and collapsible 'Other ways to share', dispersing intent.
fixes: Consolidate share options into an iOS/Android native share sheet button alongside 'Copy link'.
Demote 'YOUR ENTITY ID' into a collapsed advanced card with a quick copy icon.

top_issues: The quote explanation text under 'You receive' explains both market fill and resting limit orders in one paragraph, creating cognitive overload.
The collateral tariff disclaimer ('H1 collateral tariff: 0.1 WETH base...') introduces heavy off-chain channel mechanics into what looks like a simple swap.
fixes: Separate swap mode clearly: segmented toggle for 'Market (Instant)' vs 'Limit' instead of explanatory prose.
Collapse collateral tariff details into a summary fee line with expandable breakdown.

top_issues: The order book view displays 10 bid and 10 ask levels with 4-decimal precision, which consumes excessive vertical space on mobile and pushes the action button to screen edge.
Tap interaction cue ('Tap a level to fill the ticket...') is small grey text easily missed beneath the ladder.
fixes: Default mobile orderbook depth to 5 levels each with a 'Show more' toggle, keeping spread and action button visible above the fold.
Highlight hovered/tapped book level with an active row state indicator.

top_issues: Banner 'Account opening requested with zero credit. Prepare incoming capacity after confirmation' overlaps and crowds the interactive slider card below.
Network tags (Testnet -> H1 -> Tron) look like routing hops rather than distinct settlement blockchain domains.
fixes: Integrate account status alert directly into the destination account selector card rather than a floating notification banner.
Use distinct chain badges/icons for source and target network indicators.

top_issues: The bottom CTA 'Swap USDC for WETH' directly overlaps the slider labels ('Collateral', 'New credit') due to an uncontrolled fixed sheet height / z-index clash.
Extending credit limit has its own nested CTA ('Extend credit limit') immediately above the main swap CTA, creating dual conflicting actions.
fixes: Fix the bottom button dock styling: add proper bottom-bar background scrim with padding so floating content cannot render underneath button text.
Sequence the flow: require user to extend capacity first, or bundle authorization into a single atomic action step.

top_issues: Action grid has 5 buttons (Pay, Extend credit, Swap, Manage, Dispute) arranged in an asymmetric 3+2 layout that disrupts visual rhythm.
Color legend ('secured (collateral)', 'promised', 'you owe', 'credit room', 'in flight') uses very small dot indicators with subtle color variations.
fixes: Reorganize header actions into a balanced 4-action grid (Pay, Receive/Extend, Swap, Dispute) with secondary settings under an overflow icon.
Group the bar legend directly into a consolidated balance inspector component.

top_issues: 'THIS ACCOUNT' metadata list mixes protocol state ('Frames signed: 15', 'Status: Open') with financial risk metrics ('They owe you, uncovered: $90.00').
The dispute timeline row ('If you dispute, they answer within 1 d') doesn't indicate how to initiate or what evidence is held.
fixes: Separate financial balance posture from technical state into distinct sub-cards: 'Risk & Collateral' vs 'Session Diagnostics'.
Make the dispute row interactive, linking directly to the pre-filled dispute verification screen.

top_issues: Filter pills (All, Payments, Swaps, Settlement, Accou...) are truncated on the right without a fade indicator showing horizontal scrollability.
Timestamps only show seconds/minutes ('04:41:46') without relative contextual labels (e.g., '2m ago').
fixes: Add a subtle right gradient fade mask on the horizontal filter list to signal scrollable categories.
Use human-readable relative time ('2 mins ago') with full ISO timestamp on detail tap.

top_issues: The detail card appears as a bottom sheet over the activity list but lacks clear dismissal buttons other than the small 'X' at top right.
'2 committed entries' row provides no breakdown of what the two entries actually represent.
fixes: Allow swiping down on sheet handle and add a prominent bottom button ('Done' / 'Close').
Make '2 committed entries' expandable to show the input transition and corresponding state frame.

top_issues: The 'Dollars per pixel' slider is abstract and hard to calibrate without seeing immediate visual feedback on actual balances.
Toggle list under 'HOME' switches off fundamental layers ('On-chain wallet', 'Reserve', 'Accounts') without warning user of potential disorientation.
fixes: Show a live preview bar directly underneath the slider that expands/contracts as the user slides.
Add brief explanatory subtext explaining that disabling toggles only filters view display, not funds.

top_issues: 'AT THIS SCALE' diagnostic block shows pixel lengths (10 px, 100 px, 1,000 px, 10,000 px) which is technical debug information rather than user settings.
Danger buttons ('Forget vault') and utility buttons ('Reveal recovery phrase', 'Lock') have inconsistent sizes and visual prominence.
fixes: Move 'AT THIS SCALE' into an advanced developer/diagnostics sub-menu.
Separate Vault security controls into dedicated section with clear high-friction destructive styling for 'Forget vault'.

top_issues: The 3-card grid (Wallet, Reserve, Account) repeated identically in 'FROM' and 'TO' creates repetitive visual blocks on mobile.
Current balance bars inside small cards are narrow and difficult to accurately discern.
fixes: Use a unified segmented transfer selector or interactive source-to-target visual flow diagram.
Display explicit numerical balance with percentage selector chips (25%, 50%, Max) below Amount.

top_issues: 'WHAT HAPPENS' explanation is formatted as a radio item ('Fund you through H1') suggesting an interactive choice when it is actually an informational notice.
'Add to batch' button floats awkwardly on the left above the explanation card.
fixes: Format 'WHAT HAPPENS' as a clear transaction summary breakdown without radio button glyphs.
Place 'Add to batch' as a secondary outlined action adjacent to 'Sign & send'.

top_issues: Top navigation grid has 5 cards with 2 full rows and an orphan card ('Ownership') taking half width.
'WHERE YOUR MONEY STANDS' table repeats the home screen breakdown without actionable shortcuts to resolve the $90.00 promised/unsecured balance.
fixes: Format top tools as an evenly balanced 6-item grid or structured list with right chevron indicators.
Add an inline action button ('Collateralize' / 'Dispute') directly next to 'Promised by hubs $90.00'.

top_issues: 'Depository may pull 0.00' text under each token in ON-CHAIN WALLET is crypto-legalistic and confuses ordinary holding balances.
The 'Move into reserve' card sits as an odd single action card inside the token list.
fixes: Replace 'Depository may pull' with clear 'Allowance / Approved' status indicator.
Place 'Move into reserve' as a full-width persistent button at card bottom or top action bar.

top_issues: Bottom action buttons ('Receive USDC from H1', 'USDC to my on-chain wallet', etc.) are stacked as heavy identical full-width dark buttons.
The 'Prepare to receive' card occupies the top half with fine micro-numbers (25.500023 USDC) without visual pause.
fixes: Group the destination buttons into a segmented modal or structured action list with distinct icon badges.
Round micro-fractions on primary UI cards to 2 decimal places with full precision on hover/detail tap.

top_issues: Token selection pills (USDC, WETH, USDT) wrap awkwardly into an asymmetrical 2x2 grid.
Switch between 'Lend' and 'Borrow' is presented as small text tabs pushed down below token selection.
fixes: Place Lend/Borrow toggle at the very top of the form as the primary intent switch.
Align token selectors horizontally with clean horizontal scrolling or a compact dropdown.

top_issues: 'H1 POOL' diagnostics (Available 0.00, Borrowed 0.00, Active principal 0.00) show all zeros without empty-state explanation.
Basis point calculation input '100 = 1.00% per term' does not show expected annualized yield (APY).
fixes: Show projected annual APY alongside term interest calculation.
Add helper text for inactive pools explaining when hub matching occurs.

top_issues: Card content is text-heavy explanation ('One key runs this entity today: yours. A board can grow...') with limited interactive affordances for key rotation.
'Kind: Self-issued (its id is the hash of its board)' uses internal cryptosystem jargon.
fixes: Add explicit actionable buttons ('Add signer', 'Initiate rotation', 'Export governance config').
Simplify board identity description with a visual quorum graphic (e.g. 1/1 key badge).

top_issues: The header prominently states '$40.00 Enforceable right now' but does not immediately provide a 1-tap emergency exit/settle button.
Long explanation paragraph under the breakdown bar creates unnecessary vertical height.
fixes: Add an immediate 'Exit to on-chain' or 'Settle all' CTA directly under the enforceable balance hero section.
Condense the green/violet risk explanation into a collapsible help tip.

top_issues: 'Save evidence bundle' is the single primary CTA in the Ledger section, but lacks visual confirmation of file format or size before tap.
Per-counterparty row shows 'nothing at risk' in bright green text while an earlier screen indicated $90.00 promised by H1, creating apparent cognitive mismatch.
fixes: Add file size/format badge to 'Save evidence bundle' ('JSON · 12 KB').
Reconcile counterparty risk status: if H1 owes $90 without collateral, label as '90.00 unsecured' rather than 'nothing at risk'.

overall.verdict: The xln mobile interface establishes an exceptionally rigorous, mathematically coherent design system with unmatched transparency regarding counterparty risk and verifiable state. However, desktop-grade cryptographic jargon and occasional viewport clipping in bottom sheets hinder fluid mobile retail execution.
priority_fixes: Fix bottom-sheet and fixed CTA layout bugs on mobile viewports (especially in 05b-swap-cross-bottom where CTA text clashes with background controls).
Streamline the onboarding and payment flow for non-technical users by progressive disclosure: hide raw hashes, tick metrics, and protocol terminology behind expandable advanced inspectors.
Consolidate and streamline the Receive / Inbound capacity workflow so users can receive payments without navigating manual credit slider adjustments.
Add direct on-chain dispute and settlement execution buttons directly on the Account and Sovereignty screens rather than only proof bundling.
Clean up action grids across Account and Manage screens into balanced, thumb-friendly 4-card grids or standard iOS/Android action sheets.

personas.name: Maya
personas.verdict: The design looks slick and safe, but seeing talk of depository escrow, co-signed frames, and hubs makes me terrified I'll lose my $20.
blockers: 01-home: Jargon regarding 'Reserve' vs 'Promised' vs 'On-chain' overwhelms simple payment mental model.
04-receive: '25.50 capacity via H1' and 'Prepare incoming account' prevent simple address sharing.

personas.name: Tomasz
personas.verdict: Brilliant execution of channel liquidity semantics—seeing the absolute 1:1 scale bar for local balance versus credit limit is something Lightning has needed for years.

personas.name: Anya
personas.verdict: Having a genuine L2 orderbook with tick spreads on my phone is incredible, though having to worry about bilateral collateral tariffs during a swap adds unexpected friction.
blockers: 05b-swap-cross-bottom: Button overlap glitch prevents clean order submission.
05-swap: Unclear distinction between market execution and resting limit orders in the input card.

personas.name: Ravi
personas.verdict: The Sovereignty view and signed frame receipts give me the exact auditable proof and enforceable on-chain figures my board demands.
blockers: 08-activity-detail / 03-receipt: Needs one-click full cryptographic bundle export directly from individual receipt modals.

personas.name: Sofia
personas.verdict: Generating a payment link and getting a clean verified receipt with settled frame data was fast, though setting inbound capacity is an annoying hurdle.
blockers: 04-receive: Confusing 'Capacity via H1' requirement before a client can pay an invoice.

personas.name: Kenji
personas.verdict: The dispute parameters, challenge window timers, and offline evidence bundle export prove this protocol doesn't rely on blind trust.
blockers: 06-account: The 'Dispute' button should lead to an explicit simulated dispute execution preview before submitting on-chain.

personas.name: Lena
personas.verdict: Paying takes just a couple taps, but several screens have buttons jammed right against the navigation bar that are hard to hit with one thumb.
blockers: 02-pay-bottom / 05b-swap-cross-bottom: Action buttons clash with safe-area spacing and overlapping sheet controls.

personas.name: Marcus
personas.verdict: The desk-level clarity on bilateral credit lines, collateralization ratios, and counterparty exposure gives me total control over my liquidity posture.

personas.name: Fatima
personas.verdict: Moving funds across networks shows clear fees, but the multi-step account opening and credit extension sliders made the cross-chain swap intimidating.
blockers: 05b-swap-cross: Complex 'Prepare to receive' credit slider blocks smooth cross-chain settlement.

personas.name: Dmitri
personas.verdict: The single absolute scale bar and rigorous green-vs-violet distinction convey counterparty risk and protocol value proposition better than any crypto pitch deck I've seen in five years.
